question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A person who examines, diagnoses and treats eyes
solution:
The correct answer is '**Ophthalmologist**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Ophthalmologist**'.
 
• It means 'a specialist in the branch of medicine concerned with the study and treatment of disorders and diseases of the eye'. (आंखों के विकारों और रोगों के अध्ययन और उपचार से संबंधित दवा की शाखा में एक विशेषज्ञ)
 
 
• *Example: Krishna's father is a famous **ophthalmologist**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Ophthalmologist.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of other words:

 
 
• **Chronobiologist**: the branch of biology concerned with cyclical physiological phenomena. (चक्रीय शारीरिक घटना से संबंधित जीव विज्ञान की शाखा)
 
• **Optician**: a person whose job is to test eyes, sell glasses, etc. (आँखों की जाँच करना, चश्‍मा बेचना आदि काम करने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
• **Econometrist**: an economist who uses statistical and mathematical methods. (एक अर्थशास्त्री जो सांख्यिकीय और गणितीय विधियों का उपयोग करता है)
